english.title: Operator cause / permit aircraft to fly for commercial air transport w/o scheme for regulation of flight times
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a Part-CAT aeroplane which was registered in the United Kingdom and had a flight crew of at least two pilots, caused or permitted an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), to fly for the purpose of commercial air transport when

(C)_[the scheme for the regulation of flight times required under Subpart Q of Annex III to the Technical Harmonisation Regulation or Part-CAT had not been approved by the CAA]_
(D)_[you had not taken all such steps as were reasonably practicable to ensure that the provisions for the scheme for the regulation of flight times would be complied with in relation to every person flying in that aeroplane as a member of its crew]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 179 and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the operator of a Part-CAT aeroplane which was registered in the United Kingdom and had a flight crew of at least two pilots, caused or permitted an aircraft to fly for the purpose of commercial air transport
when the scheme for the regulation of flight times required under Subpart Q of Annex III to the Technical Harmonisation Regulation or Part-CAT had not been approved by the CAA OR
you had not taken all such steps as were reasonably practicable to ensure that the provisions for the scheme for the regulation of flight times would be complied with in relation to every person flying in that aeroplane as a member of its crew

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
